text: Reception reported 92 of 183 rooms occupied on Wednesday 25 Nov (50.3%), 43 of them Rabdan, up from 91 on 24 Nov. There were no check-ins or check-outs. Reception logged 2 new inquiries, 1 property viewing, 1 booking confirmation, no renewals, and 5 guest complaints, all resolved.
Reports for 25 Nov came from Operations (two updates), Reception, Maintenance, IT, Accounts, HR & Admin, the Flower shop and AJ1881. No separate Housekeeping report was seen.

Maintenance logged 11 completed jobs, all marked done, including the room 1112 AC relay, the room 1601 FCU leak and lights, 9 fused basement lights, the main entrance glass-door lock cylinder and the B3 lift lobby ceiling tiles. Still pending: ceiling painting in rooms 509–511, basement wall repair and painting, B2 drainage chamber cleaning and the remaining basement lights.

Waiting on management approval: the lift AMC, the Honest Automatic flap barrier quotation, the room 710 FCU motor rewinding, the room 801 guest’s refund request, IHC’s requested contract clause on missed services, the Reneco Tawtheeq (UAE Pass access), the Fortis café payment system, the Faiz Investment meeting, and AJ1881’s supplies purchase and rename to Oui Cafe.

On 25 Nov the CEO asked Operations for costed proposals on the Samha Oui Café, a central kitchen at Villa 11, pool rental for classes, the flower shop space, a larger laundry, and valet parking and car wash, plus evidence of all company outreach. Operations sent the café, central kitchen and laundry proposals; the others are pending. Accommodation proposals went to four energy and oilfield companies.

IHC will sign the flower arrangement contract once a clause reducing the fee for missed arrangements is added. Operations chased Sirius Holdings for its signed copy. PACT sent the revised manpower contract. No reply to the management office’s ADNOC status request was seen on 25 Nov.

IT fixed room 1508 Wi-Fi and key cards in rooms 210 and 1510, configured Wi-Fi for the whole tower and pulled camera cable in B2; new cameras and biometric data are still pending, and the Equal software is still slow. The Meta Soft team visited. Accounts reported no overdue rent and no cheques deposited or returned. AJ1881 sold AED 206 from 10 covers, all beverages; the flower shop reported no sales.
